children: European Central Bank policymaker Olli Rehn said on Saturday that policymakers would stay vigilant to the risk of second-round inflation effects from higher energy prices as they might creep in quietly.
"There is no sign of second-round effects, but we will stay vigilant because they might creep in quietly," the Finnish central bank chief said at an event in Bangkok.
